_comment: MANUAL DATA — this file drives the home-page dashboard, the Tools & Dashboards 'Command Center Snapshot', and the Governance leadership tiles. Edit values here and refresh the page; no HTML changes needed. Keys starting with _ are documentation and are ignored by the site.
_comment_hero_stats: HERO STATS = the four big numbers under the home-page banner. 'value' is the number (it animates on load), 'label' is the small uppercase text beneath it. Order here = left-to-right on the page.
_comment_metrics_snapshot: METRICS SNAPSHOT = the four tiles in the Command Center section (also reused on tools-dashboards.html). tone/delta_tone control color: ok=green, warn=amber, info=blue, crit=red, gold=dark-gold; delta_tone '' = neutral gray.
_comment_ato_donut: ATO DONUT = the authorization-mix ring chart. 'center' is the number in the middle; each segment needs label, value, and color (use the CSS variables shown, or any CSS color). Segment order = clockwise from 12 o'clock.
_comment_poam_severity_bars: SEVERITY BARS = 'Open POA&M by Severity'. 'value' is the number shown at the right; 'width' is the visual bar length (a percentage string — scale it yourself, e.g. largest value ≈ 80%). tone: crit/warn/gold/ok.
